home.title: Touch physics. Then name the pattern.
home.subtitle: Run an experiment, make a prediction, and reveal the equation only after it means something.

pendulum.title: Simple pendulum
pendulum.description: Discover what changes a pendulum's period through your own measurements.

lesson.explorePrompt: Drag the angle control, then release the pendulum. What do you notice?
lesson.questionPrompt: Choose one variable to investigate. Do not worry about being right yet.
lesson.experimentPrompt: Mass and gravity are locked. Compare ten swings at two different lengths.
lesson.predictionPrompt: If the string doubles in length, will the pendulum become faster or slower?
lesson.patternPrompt: Compare your measurements. Does doubling length double the period?
lesson.equationPrompt: Your observations are summarized by T = 2π√(L/g).
lesson.challengePrompt: Gravity is weaker on the Moon. Predict the period, then test it.

lab.title: Pendulum lab
lab.subtitle: All variables are unlocked. Explore freely and collect evidence.
